{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
valid_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = valid_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99
valid_orders = valid_orders[~qa_mask]

# Confirm final number of valid orders
print("Final number of valid orders (completed, non-QA):", len(valid_orders))

# Check distribution of channels and segments in valid data
print("Channel distribution in valid data:")
print(valid_orders['channel'].value_counts())

print("Customer segment distribution by channel in valid data:")
print(pd.crosstab(valid_orders['channel'], valid_orders['customer_segment']))

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rates = valid_orders.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rates by channel:")
print(conversion_rates)

# Compute the difference (email - paid_search)
difference = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']
print(f"Difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search): {difference}")"}
